findings.summary: H/B/R constrained objective derives its increment, including equality reduction, bounds and infeasibility cases. Pinned O0/O2 endpoint/writer/readback fixture passes; it is manufactured and does not run the production pipeline.

Writer only allows estimator-only artifact with exact FAILED/AUTHORITY pipeline/stage receipts and recomputes endpoint budget/evaluation. Physical-contract reader passes. Canonical diagnostic CLI returns INVALID/UNBOUND, candidate REJECTED because this fixture lacks operational geometry/support/stage evidence and has failed pipeline status.

Actual KDM6 property-stage 16-mask references and active-to-target reentry pass under O0/O2. Hook precedes n0 reconstruction, substep counting, rate application and microphysics; does not establish complete process.
Full KDM6 module probe stopped at mask 5 with ProgB unsupported PSD state after masks 0–4; masks 6–15 and O2 remain open.

Direct first violation: ice mass_only QI=3.5308575789291633e-35 kg kg-1, NI=0 m-3 at i=133, call_lat_index=2, k=1. Partialhost rejected at admission; post-call outputs missing and step completion not established.

Correct channel offsets, optional output initialization and QI-tendency gate tested locally. No driver accumulation/coupled-host test; DEL dry-carrier equivalence and exact upstream cause remain unproven.
Static review found no PR73 change to staged commit/remap routines and no defect.
PR73 additions do not add arbitrary density cap/floor/deletion; paired-positive classification is not full PSD validation.

limitations: No actual 12 UTC candidate or operational authority established.
Full KDM6 process, full-mask module coverage, conservation, energy, observation fit, and native 12 UTC approval are not established.
Property-stage hook excludes n0 reconstruction and subsequent rate/process application.
